name: BossNotifier
teaser: v1.2.1 out now! Know which bosses spawned in your raid! Get notifications at spawn with locations.
description:
BossNotifier

Know your enemies before they know you! BossNotifier alerts you to boss spawns at raid start and displays real-time 3D markers above their heads.

Supported Bosses: Reshala, Tagilla, Killa, Glukhar, Shturman, Sanitar, Zryachiy, Kaban, Kollontay, Partisan, Goons, Cultists, Rogues, Blood Hounds, Santa Claus, Punisher, Legion

Custom Boss Mod Support: Automatically detects and adds notifications/markers for RUAF Comehome, UNTAR, and Black Division Tactical Toaster bosses if you have those mods installed - no extra setup needed.

📖 Description

Notifications

  • Get notified which bosses spawned when the raid begins
  • See where bosses spawned (e.g., “Reshala has been located near Dormitory”)
  • Get alerted when you enter a boss’s vicinity (✓ checkmark)
  • Press O anytime to see current boss locations
  • Lock features behind Intel Center levels f

3D Markers

  • Floating markers above boss heads that update in real-time
  • Show/hide distance and boss name
  • Full RGB color customization
  • Option to only show markers when you can see the boss
  • Press P to toggle markers on/off

Custom Boss Mods

  • Automatically detects RUAF Comehome, UNTAR Toaster if installed
  • Each group gets its own notifications, 3D markers, and configurable marker color/character
  • Nothing to configure - just install the boss mod and BossNotifier picks it up
⚙️ Configuration

All settings configurable via F12 menu:

General

  • Keyboard Shortcut (default: O)
  • Show Bosses on Raid Start

Intel Center Unlocks *(set to 4 to disab

  • Notification unlock level
  • Location unlock level
  • Detection unlock level

Boss Markers

  • Enable/Disable markers
  • Toggle markers key (default: P)
  • Show through walls
  • Customizable marker: ▼ ▽ ↓ ● ◆ ★ ⚠ ☠ ◉ ▲
  • Show boss name
  • Show distance
  • Font size
  • Base/Max scale
  • Visibility distance
  • Marker color
  • Each custom boss group (RUAF, UNTAR, Black Division) gets its own marker character/color settings
📥 Installation
  1. Download the latest release
  2. Extract the archive
  3. Copy BepInEx folder to your SPT directory
  4. Start the game and configure via F12 SPT/ └── BepInEx/ └── plugins/ └── BossNotifier.dll
⚠️ Known Issues
  • Multiplayer (Fika) sync is not currently supported - the previous sync addon has been pulled due to reliability issues (host extract problems, unreliable Headless sync). Singleplayer is fully functional. Will revisit multiplayer support once it can be properly tested.

Found a bug? Report it in the comments!
